product_metadata.title: Zuvas Desk Fan, USB Powered Small Fan Quiet Portable Fan Personal Mini Fan 3 Speeds Small Fan 70° Adjustable Head for Indoor Home Office Bedroom, Black
features: 【Mighty & Powerful】Compact mini size: 6.5 x 3.5 x 5.1 in, equipped with a high-quality and long-lifespan brushless motor, which offers strong and constant power to keep desk fan working long time in an excellent performance.

【USB Powered Only】 A 1.5 m long USB cable linked behind will help the table fan connect with any USB interface like USB hub, power bank, PC/laptop, adapter, super convenient for you to enjoy the cool winds at home, office, or when you go for outdoor activities: camping, picnic, sports events, concerts.

【Adjustable 3 Wind Speeds】 Press the button 1-3 times behind the small USB fan to set a proper wind speed among low/ medium/ high mode, certainly it will meet all your needs to drive the hot splash and tiredness away and keep you in a refreshed condition.

【70° Rotation Range】The head of the fan could be 0-70°rotatable, a considerate upgraded design for much wider blowing range to optimize your using experience, moreover, there are 4 silicone non-slip mats under the base to provide stable support.

【Whisper Quiet】 Even running in the strongest mode, the noise is still less than 45dB, 10% lighter than similar products on the market. Zuvas desk fan helps you feel comfortable and cool in the summer but won't bother you when sleeping, studying or working.
